facts.business: Veerkrupa Jewellers Limited is engaged in the jewellery business, maintaining gram-wise inventory records for its operations.

auditor.name: M/s. Shah Karia & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (a) not maintaining proper and updated books of account and financial records for the period ended March 31, 2026, with a reconciliation difference of ₹62,85,441 pertaining to sales transactions of the Narol Branch; (b) not reconciling tax balances and transactions with GST portals and statutory returns, with a difference of ₹3.09 lakh between GST balances per books and GST portal; (c) inventory records not detailed, lacking item-wise identification and precise valuation data, with management's valuation of inventory totaling Rs. 1718.10 lacs relying on estimates rather than formal documentation or physical verification.

key_risks: Qualified audit opinion due to inadequate books of account and financial records
Unreconciled GST balances and transactions with material unexplained variances
Inventory records not detailed, lacking item-wise identification and precise valuation data, relying on estimates
Potential tax liabilities, interest, penalties, or provisions required due to GST reconciliation issues
